YOUR OPTIONS:
• Reject the offer: Both you and employer earn 0
• Accept with effort 1-10 (or 3-10 for limited discretion contracts)

YOUR PROFIT = wage - effort

You can choose any effort level allowed by your contract.

RESPONSE FORMAT: single integer (0 to reject, or your chosen effort level)
experiment_context:
LABOR MARKET EXPERIMENT - 15 Periods

9 employers (E1-E9) and 9 employees (W1-W9) are randomly matched each period.

CONTRACT TYPES:
• FULL discretion: Employee chooses effort 1-10, employer earns 5 per unit
• LIMITED discretion: Employee chooses effort 3-10, employer earns 4 per unit

PAYOFFS:
• Employer profit = (multiplier × effort) - wage
• Employee profit = wage - effort
• Rejection = both earn 0

BASE TREATMENT: No information about employee history is available.

You must decide whether to trust employees without knowing their track record.
